title: DemoCo DM-24 Monitor User Guide (demo fixture)

sections.heading: Ports
sections.text: Rear panel, left to right: power input, HDMI 1, HDMI 2, DisplayPort, USB-B upstream, headphone out.

sections.heading: Selecting the input source
sections.text: Press the Input button on the bottom edge, then use the joystick to choose HDMI 1, HDMI 2 or DisplayPort. Auto-select can be enabled in Menu > Input > Auto.

sections.heading: No signal troubleshooting
sections.text: If 'No signal' appears: confirm the computer is on, reseat the cable at both ends, and select the matching input source.

sections.heading: Wall mount
sections.text: Uses VESA 100x100 mounting with M4 screws, 10 mm. Remove the stand first by pressing the release button.
